lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately five distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a staggered grid-like distribution across the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a rectangular lattice where the primary blobs act as nodal points, most prominent in the area dorsal to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow-induced low-intensity values on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique labyrinthine or whorled pigmentation pattern, deviating from the standard grid, is located immediately dorsal to the pectoral fin insertion. Additionally, multiple small teleost fish are visible in the ventral-lateral water column near the pectoral fin.
